name: comp-131
title: Merge Strategy Split Button
description: A commit row pairs a title and meta line with a light split button. The wide half shows the chosen merge method; the chevron half drops a menu of three strategies, each explained in a sentence.
use: A primary action has two or three variants a small menu should offer, like choosing how to merge a branch.
avoid: The menu descriptions are fixed prose and the main button runs no merge action of its own.
a11y: The chevron is labelled Options and the menu behaves as a radio group, but the main button performs no action itself. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card row holds a bold commit title and a grey meta line on the left. On the right sits a light split control: a wide label segment and a narrow chevron segment. Opening it reveals a grey dropdown where each of three options has a name, a small description and a tick on the active one.
behaves: Clicking the chevron opens the menu below the button; choosing one of the three radio options moves the tick, closes the menu and swaps the main button's label. The card behind does not move.
customise: The three strategies come from an options array holding a label and a description; the selected label and menu width are set in the file.
weight: light: A split button and a small radio menu; nothing runs at rest.
